connector.name: ShipStatic
connector.registryDescription: Deploy websites from AI agents. Free at mcp.shipstatic.com. Install for the full toolset.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.shipstatic.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.shipstatic, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SHIP_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Without it, deploys behave like the hosted endpoint (public, claim URL, 3-day expiry). With it, deployments are permanent, the full toolset (custom domains, listing, account-tied ops) unlocks, and you get bigger limits.
